```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(tidymodels)
      
# Add any other libraries here



```


```{r load-data}
# load your data 
bike_data <- read_csv("data/SeoulBikeData.csv")
glimpse(bike_data)
bike_data <- bike_data %>%
  clean_names()
names(bike_data)

bike_data <- bike_data %>%
  rename(
    temperature = temperature_yin,
    dew_point_temperature = dew_point_temperature_yin
  )

names(bike_data)
sum(is.na(bike_data))
nrow(bike_data)
nrow(distinct(bike_data))
bike_clean <- bike_data %>%
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

glimpse(bike_clean)

nrow(bike_clean)
bike_clean %>%
  distinct(date, hour) %>%
  nrow()

#Research Question1: and see How does bike rental demand vary across different hours of the day sons?
hourly_rentals <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(hour) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
#Diagram1: "Average hourly bike rentals in Seoul"
ggplot(hourly_rentals, aes(x = hour, y = avg_rentals)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Average hourly bike rentals in Seoul",
    x = "Hour of the Day",
    y = "Average Number of Bike Rentals Per Hour"
  )+
  theme_minimal()
  
#Diagram2: "Average Hourly Bike Rentals by Season in Seoul"
  seasonal_avg <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(seasons) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
  ggplot(seasonal_avg,
       aes(
         x = factor(seasons,
                    levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")),
                    y = avg_rentals,
                    fill = seasons
                    )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bike Rentals by Season in Seoul",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Average Number of Bike Rentals Per Hour"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
#Diagram3: "Hourly Bike Rental Patterns Differ Across Seasons"
  seasonal_rentals <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(seasons, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
ggplot(seasonal_rentals,
       aes(x = hour, y = avg_rentals, colour = seasons)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Hourly Bike Rentals Patterns by Season",
    x = "Hour of the Day",
    y = "Average Hourly Bike Rentals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
  
#Research Question2 : How do weather conditions affect bike rental demand in Seoul?

#Diagram1: "Bike Rentals vs Temperature"
ggplot(bike_clean,
       aes(x = temperature,
           y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(
    title = "Bike Rentals vs Temperature",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Hourly Bike Rentals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#Diagram2:"Bike Rentals vs Humidity"
ggplot(bike_clean,
       aes(x = humidity_percent,
           y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(
    title = "Bike Rentals vs Humidity",
    x = "Humidity (%)",
    y = "Hourly Bike Rentals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
#Diagram3: "Average Bike Rentals by Rainfall Level"
rainfall_level_avg <- bike_clean %>%
  mutate(rain_level = case_when(
    rainfall_mm == 0 ~ "No Rain",
    rainfall_mm > 0 & rainfall_mm <= 2 ~ "0-2 mm",
    rainfall_mm > 2 & rainfall_mm <= 5 ~ "2-5 mm",
    rainfall_mm > 5 ~ "Above 5 mm"
  )) %>%
  group_by(rain_level) %>%
  summarise(avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count),
            n = n()
            )

ggplot(rainfall_level_avg,
       aes(x = factor(rain_level,
                      levels = c("No Rain", "0-2 mm", "2-5 mm", "Above 5 mm")),
           y = avg_rentals
           )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bike Rentals by Rainfall Level",
    x = "Rainfall Level",
    y = "Average Hourly Bike Rentals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


#Model 1: Weather-only Multiple Linear Regression

temp_fit <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  fit(rented_bike_count ~ temperature,
      data = bike_clean)

tidy(temp_fit)

glance(temp_fit)

weather_data <- bike_clean %>%
  mutate(rain_status = case_when(
    rainfall_mm == 0 ~ "No Rain",
    rainfall_mm > 0 ~ "Rain"
  ))

weather_fit <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  fit(rented_bike_count ~ temperature +
        humidity_percent + rain_status,
      data = weather_data)

tidy(weather_fit)

glance(weather_fit)

# Model 2: Multiple Linear Regression with Additional Variables

weather_fit_2 <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  fit(rented_bike_count ~ temperature +
        humidity_percent + rain_status +
        factor(hour) + seasons + holiday,
      data = weather_data)

tidy(weather_fit_2)

glance(weather_fit_2)

# Residual Plot for Model 2

weather_aug_2 <- augment(weather_fit_2$fit)

ggplot(weather_aug_2,
       aes(x = .fitted, y = .resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Residual Plot for Adjusted Weather Model",
    x = "Fitted Values",
    y = "Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

glance(temp_fit)
glance(weather_fit)
glance(weather_fit_2)
  
  
  

#RQ3: How do bike rental patterns differ between holidays and non-holidays?

#Diagram1: "Daily Bike Rentals: Holidays vs Non-Holidays"
daily_rentals <- bike_clean %>%
    group_by(date, holiday) %>%
  summarise(sum_rentals = sum(rented_bike_count),
            n_hours = n()
            ) %>%
  filter(n_hours == 24)

ggplot(daily_rentals,
       aes(x = holiday,
           y = sum_rentals,
           fill = holiday)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rentals: Holidays vs Non-Holidays",
    x = "Day Type",
    y = "Daily Bike Rentals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#Diagram2: "Hourly Bike Rental Patterns by Holiday Status"
holiday_hourly <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(holiday, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
ggplot(holiday_hourly,
       aes(x = hour,
           y = avg_rentals,
           colour = holiday)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Hourly Bike Rental Patterns by Holiday Status",
    x = "Hour of the Day",
    y = "Average Hourly Bike Rentals",
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
 
    



```
